note: Every sum the black notebook states, as written. The Accounts tab is the ledgers' sales; these are the costs the ledgers never record — frames, insurance, paper, the studio painted, a phonograph, two watches — and the few receipts, which are hers. Declared by hand and checked against the page by scripts/framing.mjs, as the framing register is: an entry whose pattern matches nothing fails the build. Nothing is totalled, converted or adjusted, on the rule the transcriptions follow.
